vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 30s taught the man in his 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm Wound Care.
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
🛡️ Juan, Donna, Esteban and Nelson met them at the door — 4 put down. Juan, Donna, Esteban are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Giulia just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Juan just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Donna just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Donna, Esteban, Nelson, Sari and Giulia met them at the door — 5 put down. Donna, Esteban, Nelson, Sari, Giulia are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Victor, Fatima, Vasyl and Caleb met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Victor, Fatima, Vasyl, Caleb are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Victor, Fatima, Vasyl, Caleb and Quynh met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Victor, Fatima, Vasyl, Caleb, Quynh are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl, Caleb and Sibusiso met them at the door — 1 put down. Caleb, Sibusiso didn't come back. Vasyl is hurt.
